name: local-mail-claude-extension
display_name: Local Mail — GMX and Proton Bridge
description: Read-only mail and attachment access on Windows, with locally encrypted credentials.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read a message without changing flags

gmx_enabled.title: Enable GMX
gmx_enabled.description: Enable after saving GMX credentials with the local setup script.

gmx_region.title: GMX server region
gmx_region.description: Enter net for German GMX or com for international GMX.

proton_enabled.title: Enable Proton Bridge
proton_enabled.description: Enable after configuring local Bridge credentials and its exported certificate.

proton_port.title: Bridge IMAP port
proton_port.description: Use the IMAP port shown in Proton Bridge.

proton_tls.title: Bridge TLS mode
proton_tls.description: Enter starttls or tls, matching Bridge settings.

proton_certificate.title: Exported Bridge certificate
proton_certificate.description: PEM public certificate exported locally from Bridge. Required when Proton is enabled; never select a private key.

download_root.title: Attachment download directory
download_root.description: Existing local directory. Files are saved in its LocalMailAttachments subfolder.
